title: Dareplane proof of concept: STN LFP, ECoG and EOG during the CopyDraw task with open- and closed-loop DBS (1 Parkinson's disease patient)
description: Intracranial recordings from one Parkinson's disease patient with externalised bilateral subthalamic DBS leads and an epidural ECoG strip over left primary motor cortex, acquired on days 2-4 after implantation. The patient performed the CopyDraw task with DBS off, continuous open-loop DBS, and closed-loop adaptive DBS controlled by the Dareplane platform. The dataset serves as a proof of concept for Dareplane, a modular open-source platform for BCI research and closed-loop deep brain stimulation.
methods_description: STN local field potentials (16 directional-lead contacts), 4-contact epidural ECoG over left M1 and 4 EOG channels were recorded with a Neuro Omega system at 22 kHz across 41 recordings in three sessions. Conditions were stimulation off, open-loop stimulation on, and closed-loop adaptive stimulation (day 4). Events include hardware port markers and stimulation markers. Auxiliary analog inputs and original XDF/behavioural files are in sourcedata.
